entries.reason: Open-ended JSON-compatible values need one Protobuf representation that retains distinct Int64 and Double values across typed domain snapshots.
entries.schema: eve.persistence.proto.DynamicValue is a recursive oneof for null, bool, Int64, finite Double, string, list and object.
entries.version: The shared value message is embedded inside versioned owning-domain messages; it is not an independent persistent root.
entries.migration: Owning domains migrate their outer schema and can convert prior JSON values through the same dynamic runtime contract.
entries.unknown_fields: Owning-domain binary restore rejects unknown fields recursively; the codec rejects unset kinds, false null markers, duplicate object keys and non-finite doubles.
entries.restore_atomicity: Decode builds an independent Value; encode swaps a complete temporary message only after every nested value succeeds.

entries.reason: Foundation persistence modules share a typed conversion boundary for genuinely dynamic data.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for the common codec.

entries.thread_affinity: The caller owns the input and output values; conversion has no shared state or callbacks.
cost_notes: Encoding and decoding cost linear time in recursively owned value size per persistence operation.
